# magic2 upstream provenance

This directory is a vendored snapshot of the upstream repository:

- Source: https://github.com/Feralthedogg/magic2
- Ref: `main`
- Pinned commit: `b890268b2be97a73977c73a2110b5b5f0af65500`
- Upstream license: MIT; see [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)
- Snapshot date: 2026-09-21

The upstream files retain their original MIT license and notices. This metadata
file records the source and pin for LLAM's vendoring workflow; it is not part of
the upstream snapshot. LLAM's private adapter currently consumes the vendored
single-header implementation through `src/internal/magic2.h`, whose bytes are
verified against this snapshot.
